# Code of conduct

Alma Sync is made by students, for students. Be kind when you open issues, comment, or send pull requests.

## Do

- Be respectful, even when you disagree.
- Give helpful feedback on the code, not the person.
- Help newcomers who are still learning.

## Don't

- Insult, bully or harass anyone.
- Share someone else's grades, schedule, messages or other private info.
- Post spam or anything not related to Alma Sync.

## If something goes wrong

Tell the maintainer using the email in the README's [Report a bug](../README.md#report-a-bug) section. Reports are kept private. Anyone who breaks these rules can be removed from the project.
